extDescription.message: Use your Zwift Click as a remote for YouTube, Netflix and other video tabs while Spindro keeps your workout running.

connHint.message: Open Spindro (spindro.fit/app) in a tab and turn on Remote mode there.

targetNone.message: No tab yet: open a video in another tab

pinnedNote.message: Pinned: it stays the target even when you look at other tabs.

sitesIntro.message: Always on: Spindro, YouTube, Netflix. Other sites only after you allow them.

strongExplain.message: Lets Spindro send real key presses and enter fullscreen on pages that block scripts. Chrome then shows a banner "Spindro Remote started debugging this browser" while it works. Off by default.

strongDenied.message: Permission not granted: strong mode stays off.

helpText.message: Keep Spindro open (the mini window is handy), play a video in another tab, then switch Spindro to Remote mode. The Click now controls the last tab you looked at. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
